transcript:
SA: Kvarn Kaffe, det är Sara.
C: Hej Sara, Karim from Bistro Lyktan in Örebro.
SA: Hi Karim! What can I do for you?
C: The House Espresso, twenty kilo please.
SA: Twenty kilo House Espresso.
C: We hired a new barista, Tove. She's very good, but she pulls a lot of test shots. A lot.
SA: Ha, the good ones do.
C: So, eh, add another fifteen to the espresso. Femton more.
SA: Fifteen more on the espresso, okay.
C: Yes. Better too much than running out before Christmas.
SA: True. Anything else?
C: No, that's all. Only the espresso.
SA: I'll send the quote over.
C: Tack, hej då!
